上官程赶到公司门口的时候，恰好撞见他父亲上官清越从大楼里出来，正站在台阶上等车。

十月的阳光不冷不热地照着，上官清越穿着一身深灰色的西装，头发梳得一丝不苟，看上去和往常没什么两样。

前世，就是今天，这辆车开出去没多久，就在前面的十字路口与一辆公交车发生了碰撞。父亲当场死亡，公交车上更是伤亡无数，造成了极其恶劣的社会影响。

虽然这个父亲对他的关照不多，但对方毕竟是他的亲生父亲，这点血脉情缘是要还的。

另外，父亲去世之后，继母任荣荣便开始为所欲为。

夺取集团权力，各种名义侵占股权，伪造遗书，将上官家继承人之位交给了上官淇。

上官程本就身体不好，接连遭受打击身体彻底垮了。

为了避免悲剧重演，上官程必须拦住父亲，不让他乘坐那辆车。

所以今天，他必须拦住他。哪怕用最蛮横的方式。

一辆黑色的迈巴赫缓缓驶过来，稳稳地停在台阶下。上官清越拉开车门。

“爸。”上官程从柱子后面走出来，声音不大，但足够清晰，“稍等一下，我想跟您谈些事情。”

上官清越抬起头，看到是他，眉头皱了一下，但很快松开：“你怎么来了？身体还没恢复，要好好休息。”

上官程注意到，他的手还搭在车门把手上，随时准备坐进去。

他上前一步，“砰”的一声，替他把门关上了。

“就这么不想见自己的儿子？”上官程的声音不高不低，但带着一股压了很久的怨气，“看了就跑？”

“胡说什么？”上官清越的眉头拧得更紧了，“我有急事，得赶紧走，不能耽误。”

他又看了一眼手表，目光焦灼。

上官程不知道的是，上官清越接到密报——任蓉蓉的父亲，检察院院长任国礼，正在进行一场严重违法违纪的卖国行动。若是能当场拿到证据，就能扳倒任家，彻底摆脱任家对上官家几十年的控制。

当年上官程的生母程洁突然病逝，上官清越还在悲痛之中，就被任家做了局——和任蓉蓉一夜情，被拍下照片，被迫娶了她。他拼死反抗过，可任国礼凭借手中的权力，把上官清越的父母私自扣在了监狱里，用二老的性命威胁他。

那时上官家还不是首富，势力远不如任家。为了救自己的父母，上官清越只能签了那份婚书。

这么多年来，他对任蓉蓉没有过一丝真心。

When Shangguan Cheng rushed to the door of the company, he happened to bump into his father Shangguan Qingyue coming out of the building and standing on the steps waiting for the bus.

The October sun shone lukewarmly. Shangguan Qingyue was wearing a dark gray suit and his hair was combed meticulously. He looked no different from usual.

In the previous life, today, not long after this car drove out, it collided with a bus at the intersection in front.My father died on the spot, and there were countless casualties on the bus, which caused extremely bad social impact.

Although this father didn't pay much attention to him, he was his biological father after all, and this blood relationship had to be repaid.

In addition, after her father passed away, her stepmother Ren Rongrong began to do whatever she wanted.

Seizing the power of the group, embezzling equity under various names, forging suicide notes, and handing over the position of heir to the Shangguan family to Shangguan Qi.

Shangguan Cheng was already in poor health, and suffered a series of blows and his body completely collapsed.

In order to avoid a recurrence of the tragedy, Shangguan Cheng had to stop his father and prevent him from taking the car.

So today, he had to stop him.Even in the most brutal way.

A black Maybach drove slowly over and stopped steadily at the foot of the steps.Shangguan Qingyue opened the car door.

"Dad." Shangguan Cheng came out from behind the pillar, his voice was not loud but clear enough, "Wait a moment, I want to talk to you about something."

Shangguan Qingyue raised his head and frowned when he saw it was him, but he quickly relaxed: "Why are you here? Your body has not recovered yet, so you need to have a good rest."

Shangguan Cheng noticed that his hand was still on the car door handle, ready to sit in at any time.

He took a step forward and closed the door for him with a bang.

"You don't want to see your son that much?" Shangguan Cheng's voice was neither high nor low, but it was full of resentment that had been suppressed for a long time. "You just ran away after seeing it?"

"What nonsense are you talking about?" Shangguan Qingyue frowned even more tightly, "I have something urgent and I have to leave quickly without delay."

He glanced at his watch again, his eyes anxious.

What Shangguan Cheng didn't know was that Shangguan Qingyue had received a secret report that Ren Rongrong's father, Ren Guoli, the director of the Procuratorate, was conducting a treasonous operation that seriously violated laws and disciplines.If we can get the evidence on the spot, we can bring down the Ren family and completely get rid of the decades of control the Ren family has had over the Shangguan family.

At that time, Shangguan Cheng's biological mother Cheng Jie suddenly died of illness. Shangguan Qingyue was still grieving, so he was tricked by the Ren family - he had a one-night stand with Ren Rongrong, was photographed, and was forced to marry her.He resisted desperately, but Ren Guoli relied on his power to privately imprison Shangguan Qingyue's parents and threatened him with their lives.

At that time, the Shangguan family was not the richest man, and its power was far inferior to that of the Ren family.In order to save his parents, Shangguan Qingyue could only sign the marriage contract.

Over the years, he has never been sincere to Ren Rongrong.
